newsitem.title: USA: Mazel Stores Q4 pro forma shr higher.
newsitem.headline: Mazel Stores Q4 pro forma shr higher.

text.p: Three Months Ended Fiscal Year Ended

NOTE: (1) The reported financial data for the three months and 12 months ended January 31, 1996 reflect the combination of: the Mazel wholesale operation, Ohio retail operation, Odd Job retail operation, and Peddlers Mart retail store.

(2) Pro forma as adjusted data gives effect to the company's initial public offering and includes the combination of: the Mazel wholesale operations, Odd Job retail operations, and Peddlers Mart retail store. Pro forma as adjusted data exclude certain non-recurring charges, and give effect to the use of proceeds resulting from the company's 2.96 million share initial public offering, as well as certain adjustments to compensation expense.

(3) The special charges for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended January 25, 1997 resulted from compensation and other charges arising in connection with the company's public offering. The special charges resulted from executive signing bonuses and a loss on the disposal of the Ohio retail operation.
(4) Other (income) expense for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended January 31, 1996 included a charge for litigation expenses of $100,000 and $600,000, respectively.
